bio.text: Bruce Cozart, a Republican from Hot Springs, represents Arkansas House District 91, which includes a portion of Garland County, and is serving his 7th term.
He owns Bruce Cozart Construction, Inc., where he is a general contractor for commercial and residential buildings.
Cozart is a graduate of Lake Hamilton High School and a former member, and president, of the Lake Hamilton School Board.
He was elected president of the Arkansas Home Builders Association and is a past president of the Hot Springs Home Builders Association.
